title: Why Last Flu Season Was So Brutal
hook: Two out of three people hospitalized with the flu had skipped the shot.
closing: The shot isn't perfect, but most who landed in the hospital skipped it. Get yours.
question: Did you get your flu shot?

segments.say: Flu sent roughly 710,000 Americans to the hospital last season, making it an unusually severe year.
People 75 and older were hospitalized at nearly five times the overall rate.
Only about one in three of those hospitalized patients had actually gotten a flu shot.
